limitations: Published receipts require separate local byte-for-byte qualification before exactness is claimed
Body bytes exclude HTTP headers, TLS, TCP/IP and tunnel overhead; packet evidence is joined separately
Failed rows contain attempted upload body bytes and completely received response bodies, not proven link bytes
No WAN speed claim follows from running this summarizer
Break-even extrapolates constant per-transfer savings; it is not a measured sequence
Receiver process CPU excludes relay/cloudflared and socket wait; sender CPU includes HTTP/TLS
Failed pairs remain in receipts but are excluded from ratios; inspect failures before interpreting success-only statistics
Five fresh-cache shards of six pairs form thirty trials per case; retain all failures
All arms disable optional cold DAG warming; durable verified bytes have equal readiness
Each warm arm owns an identical separately charged raw seed; cold arms have no base
All 24 arm permutations occur before repetition; 30 trials are not a fully balanced carryover design
Insertions use a 16 MiB minus 4096-byte base; compressed input is zstd of 16 MiB minus 4096 pseudorandom bytes; exact actual lengths are in receipts
Zstd prefix is the configured pinned-library engine, not rsync/VCDIFF or exact CLI patch-from equivalence
All encoding and retained-state teardown is timed; fixture generation and independent reopened verification are separate
Cold sparse uses raw and cold prefix uses ordinary zstd; warm recipes can select raw fallback before Begin
Receiver handler CPU excludes HTTP ingress, socket writes and relay/tunnel work; no network-only time or energy claim
HTTP bodies exclude TLS, headers and packet overhead; capture completeness and relay leg scope are separate
